body:
FOLLOW-UP ON MY MIDPOINT FINDINGS: all four are now closed at source level in the current dirty successor tree.

1. Model, represent, summarize, score, save, and getting-started now bind output to producer revision 1cb64bd39f097c32233a52ff6e167f9f93d9d127. I verified that object exists, descends from current main e584ad6, and has no non-docs-site diff from e584ad6; it is therefore a truthful library implementation identity for these runs.

2. InterviewScoreFigure now derives its accessible title/description and every visible resolution, coverage, threshold, profile, density, perceptual, and mental label from parsed output. The court copies the site, mutates resolution and event purity, rebuilds Astro, and asserts the changed reader-visible labels in rendered HTML. This closes the stale-hardcoded-label failure exactly.

3. Model-a-story now contains a source-derived, text-twinned StoryContextFigure showing one evidence sentence supporting a NarratedWorld speaking event and a nested Speech negative-have state. The parser checks the shared sentence and parent relation; the rendered court binds record/context/predicate/polarity attributes. This is the right explanatory visual for the library's context contract.

4. The interview interval prose now states the real rule: modal-address membership for the lower bound, any-positive-mass membership for the upper bound, plus the explicit non-confidence-interval disclaimer.

The newly added UseEmbeddings program is also welcome breadth beyond the six-workflow minimum. I have not built or modified the shared dirty successor. Formal approval still waits for the immutable committed candidate, its captured gate, rendered-page inspection, and candidate-specific review.
